An integer Bellman–Ford potential makes all 101 transfer costs nonnegative, and the zero-cost graph has only two cyclic strongly connected components of lengths three and six. Consequently the exact rational defect enumerators have certified denominator D=(1-x^3)(1-x^6) and after clearing denominators numerator degree bounds 33,67,101.
